name: 一日一笺 · 配色提案 v04
status: proposed design direction; not user-approved; not implemented

platform.delivery: UI/VI design only; not an APK or running component

units.artboard: proposed 412 dp reference; not a device measurement

type.family: Android CJK sans; final native font asset not selected
type.brand: proposed rounded Chinese sans wordmark; no font binary included

support.color: secondary on neutral surfaces; ink on accentSoft

type.fontScale: respect system fontScale; future review at 2.0; not yet verified

touch.minimumMeaning: actual non-overlapping proposed target; glyph size is not target size

systemInsets.ime: real system keyboard; never draw keyboard as an app-owned input

editor.structure: proposed native full-screen journal editing; no desktop side panel
editor.keyboard: real Android system IME; toolbar sits above IME when open and above gesture inset when closed
editor.contentInitialState: empty; no fabricated default records, photos, tasks or applied stickers
editor.photos: actual user-selected media; design examples and placeholders are not inserted content
editor.stickers: insert only after an explicit user selection; supporting decorative materials are not presumed page data

brand.name: 小笺
brand.smallSizeRule: keep silhouette, fold and face; no tiny added accessories
brand.status: same original v02 silhouette with proposed A palette; not approved final icon package

motion.reducedMotion: static material imagery; keep input and navigation semantics intact

designEvidence.exactColorSource: palettes.json and palette-swatches.svg; generated pixels are illustrative
designEvidence.runtimeChecks: none; no native font, touch, device or screenshot accessibility validation

colorSemantics.secondaryText: secondary on background/surface only; use ink on accentSoft
colorSemantics.selectedNavigation: ink label/icon with accentSoft mark; shape and explicit selected semantics
colorSemantics.requiredFocusAndSelection: ink boundary/glyph plus non-color semantics; accent alone is decorative
colorSemantics.photoAndCloudMaterial: muted blue-gray illustrative asset hue; not cloud-sync status
colorSemantics.firstUse: empty; all generated page content is fictional design data

materials.status: v03 material differentiation retained; design-only, no mesh/render measured
materials.character: cream satin vinyl with gray-berry fold
materials.flowerAndCloud: thin muted satin resin, no neon rim
materials.cup: subdued blue-gray glazed ceramic, no forced recoloring of actual user photos
materials.lighting: neutral upper-left soft light and short contact shadows
materials.visualReferences: material look from v03, colors from palettes.json
